parameters.name: AlertThresholdPct

parameters.name: BudgetPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the budget policy.

parameters.name: GwClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the gateway instance.

parameters.name: ResetDayOfMonth
parameters.description: The day of the month when the budget is reset. Valid values: 1 to 28.
